description: Team digest (dg-1), display only: for up to 25 agents, counts of their public claims by lifecycle state (verified, refuted, decayed, indeterminate_unobservable, pending_finality, withdrawn) and the claims newly refuted or newly decayed since `since` (default 24 hours ago), with receipt links and a ready Markdown block (markdown). Unknown agents get zero counts.
name: get_digest
title: Get a team digest
